purpose: Test the existing screen's uniform cross-section constraint: change material allocation on fixed topologies, not topology or physical assumptions.
active_outcome: External reviewer can inspect a constrained optimization, retained failure and generalization boundary in the existing proof-to-pilot lane.
comparison_groups: First six use identical terminals. Honeycomb and sunflower remain separate different-embedding exploratory cases; no pooled topology ranking.
primary_metric: Arithmetic mean ideal DC effective conductance across held-out terminal pairs, larger is better, compared to original uniform-area policy in the same graph.
allocation_parameter: q_e = A_e * length_e / V, sum q = 1; lower bound q_e >= 0.1 * length_e / total_length.
training: Classical projected gradient ascent on mean effective conductance, exact numerical circuit gradients; Euclidean projection onto lower-bounded material simplex; start from original uniform cross-section.

validation.split: One deterministic shuffle of all 2016 unordered pairs; array_split into five held-out folds. Fit four folds; score fifth only after optimization returns. No allocation or hyperparameter selection uses held-out outcomes.
validation.scope: Pair-demand interpolation within already known synthetic graphs; old full-pair scenario exists. Not independent, prospective, temporal, physical or new-topology validation.

baselines: Original uniform cross-section with exactly the same volume
One preseeded random lower-bounded material allocation; not best-of-many
failure_rules: Nonfinite score/gradient or invalid budget fails run.
Laplacian identity maximum residual must be <= 1e-8; positive connected eigenmode ratio > 1e-12.
Material budget error <=1e-12 and no area-floor violation >1e-12.
Line-search failure or budget exhaustion is reported, never recoded convergence.
acceptance: Descriptive per-layout improvement only if all five held-out fold deltas exceed zero; this is not a statistical significance or championship promotion gate.
uncertainty: Report all paired fold deltas, their range and negative/zero fold counts. Folds share training data and topology; no independent confidence interval or multiple-family significance claim.
compute_accounting: Report solver calls, gradient calls, fit runtime, one held-out score runtime, uniform/random baseline score runtimes, dual gap and termination reason. Classical optimization costs extra compute.
stop_rule: Exactly eight fixed layouts times five folds, one fixed algorithm/budget and one random control. Keep every outcome; no post-result hyperparameter, topology or fold changes.
limitations: Ideal DC only; no time, frequency, noise, attenuation, heat or physical reliability.
No manufacturability, maximum radius, junction volume or overlap constraint; 10% area floor is a declared synthetic policy.
This allocates material with a classical numerical method; it does not invent a new geometry or establish superiority of a named family.
Earlier outage results used uniform areas and do not validate outages under the new allocations.
Registry statuses and historical receipts remain unchanged.
